name: KPIBar
intent: A compact, single-row stat bar of headline metrics (value + label, optional leading icon or status dot), border-separated into groups — the thin strip that sits above a dashboard's main content (map/list).
when: A one-line summary band of counts/totals above a dashboard or workspace
Metrics with tiny status dots (on-track / at-risk / critical) or small leading icons
Vertical space is tight — a card grid (KPISummary) would be too tall
whenNot: Prominent metric tiles with trends/subtitles -> use MetricCard
A responsive grid of metric tiles -> use KPISummary

chooseOver.because: KPISummary is a CARD GRID (tall); KPIBar is a COMPACT one-line bar for the top of a dashboard. Different shape, different vertical footprint.
MetricCard is a single prominent tile; KPIBar packs several small metrics into one thin row.

groups.note: Border-separated sections; each inner array is one bordered group of items. KPIBarItem = { value, label?, icon?, dot?: 'success'|'warning'|'danger'|'neutral', tone?: 'default'|'danger', hideLabelBelow?: 'sm'|'md' }. The caller computes/aggregates the values and maps domain data to groups.

dataContract.note: Presentational and stateless — no data fetching. An item shows a leading icon OR a status dot (icon wins); `tone: 'danger'` reds the value/icon; `hideLabelBelow` hides the label responsively (value always stays).

className.note: Merged onto the bar container (defaults to a border-b, h-14, px-4 top strip).

states.default: A single row of border-separated groups; each item shows value + label.
states.dot: An item with `dot` shows a small colored status dot before the value (green/amber/red/neutral).
states.icon: An item with `icon` shows a small leading icon (takes precedence over dot).
states.danger: An item with tone='danger' renders its value (and icon) in red — e.g. active safety alerts > 0.
states.responsive: Labels with hideLabelBelow collapse below sm/md; values always remain.

allowedPlacement: top strip of a dashboard content region (above a map / list / table)
forbiddenPlacement: as a grid of cards (use KPISummary)

commonMistakes.mistake: Using KPIBar where prominent metric tiles are wanted
commonMistakes.symptom: Cramped one-line metrics that should be cards
commonMistakes.fix: Use MetricCard / KPISummary for a card grid; KPIBar is the compact bar.

commonMistakes.mistake: Baking a domain type into the bar
commonMistakes.symptom: The bar can't be reused across dashboards
commonMistakes.fix: Pass generic KPIBarItem groups; let each page aggregate its data into them.

commonMistakes.mistake: Setting both icon and dot on one item
commonMistakes.fix: Use one or the other per item (icon takes precedence).

evaluationCriteria.check: KPIBar chosen for a compact one-line bar — not MetricCard (tile) or KPISummary (card grid).
groups is a non-empty array of item arrays; each item has a value; no domain type baked in.
dot is one of success/warning/danger/neutral; tone is default/danger; hideLabelBelow is sm/md.
Renders one bordered section per group and one value (+ label) per item.

notes: promotedFrom: the inline KPIStrip in packages/components/src/pages/core-org-overview.tsx (the Dashboard kpi-strip region).
refactored: ["core-org-overview now composes KPIBar (groups built from project aggregates); the local KPIStrip removed."]
siblings: MetricCard + KPISummary are the CARD-GRID widgets; KPIBar is the COMPACT-BAR widget. Kept separate by design.
